          <div class="sqs-layout sqs-grid-12 columns-12" data-type="page" data-updated-on="1570829898929" id="page-5a443918f9619a2bb2dcb40b"><div class="row sqs-row"><div class="col sqs-col-12 span-12"><div class="sqs-block html-block sqs-block-html" data-block-type="2" id="block-yui_3_17_2_16_1514418939442_8057"><div class="sqs-block-content">
<div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content>
  <h1 style="text-align:center;white-space:pre-wrap;">Sunrise BnB</h1><p style="text-align:center;white-space:pre-wrap;" class="">Sunrise BnB offers everything you need when you visit Penghu for a kitesurfing vacation.</p><p style="text-align:center;white-space:pre-wrap;" class="">We offer clean and comfortable rooms at affordable prices starting from 1400 TWD (about 45 dollars) per night.&nbsp;</p><p style="text-align:center;white-space:pre-wrap;" class="">You can enjoy long-term stay discount if you stay for a week or a month.</p>
</div>

          </a>
    </nav>

      <section id="bus-services" class="Index-page"  data-collection-id="661c7c261159cc1c4f859ade" data-parallax-id="661c7c261159cc1c4f859ade" data-edit-main-image="Background">
        <div class="Index-page-content ">
          <div class="sqs-layout sqs-grid-12 columns-12" data-type="page" data-updated-on="1713143210609" id="page-661c7c261159cc1c4f859ade"><div class="row sqs-row"><div class="col sqs-col-1 span-1"><div class="sqs-block website-component-block sqs-block-website-component sqs-block-spacer spacer-block sized vsize-1" data-block-type="1337" id="block-59bcbaf5895d82a54e13"><div class="sqs-block-content">&nbsp;</div></div></div><div class="col sqs-col-10 span-10"><div class="sqs-block html-block sqs-block-html" data-block-type="2" id="block-80b6f171d47d4def0aa5"><div class="sqs-block-content">
<div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content>
  <h1 style="text-align:center;white-space:pre-wrap;">Bus Services</h1><h2 style="white-space:pre-wrap;">You can use public transportation system to move around in Penghu.  You just need to input your destination and use google map app to find out the bus schedule.</h2><h2 style="white-space:pre-wrap;">There two bus lines, green 31 and green 32, serving Sunrise BnB.  You can take either one of them to reach Sunrise BnB. The Green 31 follows a clockwise loop from Makong to Huxi.  The Green 32 follow a counter-clockwise loop from Makong to Huxi.  </h2>
</div>
</div></div><div class="sqs-block website-component-block sqs-block-website-component sqs-block-spacer spacer-block sized vsize-1" data-block-type="1337" id="block-5f134bc6497343bcdfcc"><div class="sqs-block-content">&nbsp;</div></div></div><div class="col sqs-col-1 span-1"><div class="sqs-block website-component-block sqs-block-website-component sqs-block-spacer spacer-block sized vsize-1" data-block-type="1337" id="block-25ffb20661a50f939b9a"><div class="sqs-block-content">&nbsp;</div></div></div></div><div class="row sqs-row"><div class="col sqs-col-12 span-12"><div class="sqs-block website-component-block sqs-block-website-component sqs-block-map map-block" data-aspect-ratio="56.07142857142857" data-block-type="1337" id="block-d840e6a1cc9801e6994f"><div class="sqs-block-content">
